steps: Open the Canadian English home page.
Use Makeup navigation to open All Makeup.
Search, filter, sort, and compare visible product facts.
Open product details and inspect price, availability, description, images, and review aggregate.
Open Pro Filt'r Soft Matte Longwear Foundation.
Select the assigned inventory shade 185N and Standard 32 mL.
Add it to the bag.
Open Invisimatte Instant Setting + Blotting Powder (inventory label: Invisible Setting Powder), choose Standard 8.5 g, and add it.
Update quantity, remove, restore, and verify both items remain visible.
Begin checkout from the two-item bag.
Observe required-field validation.
Enter synthetic contact and delivery details.
Choose a fulfillment option and optionally apply FENTY10.
Choose only an opaque local-sandbox outcome and reach final review; never enter card data or place a real order.
Search for zzzz-no-match-websitebench.
Observe a zero-results explanation.
Return to All Makeup.
Inspect sign-in, registration, and no-send recovery surfaces.
Create a synthetic local account.
Sign in, save a product, inspect the account, and sign out.
Open seeded order history.
Inspect newest order status and details.
Cancel, request return, or reorder where allowed.
Return to makeup.
Open Help Center.
Reach shopping, account, and order guidance without revealing private data.
Open a nonexistent route.
Observe branded 404 copy with primary navigation.
Return to Makeup, Home, or Help.
Open sign-in and inspect identity choices.
Open registration and inspect terms and local verification guidance.
Open recovery and verify empty-field guidance without sending a message.
